name: Deploy SurrealDB v3.0 Integration with Official Library
description: Build Docker image with surrealdb>=1.0.0 and async changes, upgrade SurrealDB to v3.0 in K8s, deploy RPC API, verify variant_id persistence end-to-end

tasks.description: Update Dockerfile and build image with surrealdb library

prompt.template:
Build Docker image for metabob-rpc-api with updated dependencies:

1. Check repos/metabob-rpc-api/docker/Dockerfile.server
2. Verify surrealdb>=1.0.0 is in requirements.txt (already added)
3. Build image: cd repos/metabob-rpc-api && docker build -f docker/Dockerfile.server -t metabob-rpc-api:surrealdb-v3 .
4. Tag image: docker tag metabob-rpc-api:surrealdb-v3 metabob-rpc-api:latest
5. Verify build succeeded

Expected: Docker image builds successfully with official surrealdb library

commands: docker images | grep metabob-rpc-api | grep surrealdb-v3

tasks.description: Upgrade SurrealDB deployment to v3.0 in K8s

prompt.template:
Upgrade SurrealDB to version 3.0 in Kubernetes:

1. Edit helm/charts/metabob-rpc-api.values.yaml
2. Find surrealdb.image section
3. Update tag from '2.3.10' to '3.0.0' (or latest 3.x)
4. Save file
5. Apply changes: helmfile -f helm/helmfile.yaml sync
6. Wait for SurrealDB pod to be ready: kubectl wait --for=condition=ready pod -l app=surrealdb -n metabob --timeout=120s
7. Verify version: kubectl exec -n metabob deploy/surrealdb -- surreal version

Expected: SurrealDB 3.0.x running in metabob namespace

commands: kubectl get pods -n metabob -l app=surrealdb -o jsonpath='{.items[0].status.phase}' | grep Running
kubectl exec -n metabob deploy/surrealdb -- surreal version | grep '3.0'

tasks.description: Deploy updated RPC API with async changes

prompt.template:
Deploy updated metabob-rpc-api to Kubernetes:

1. Update deployment image: kubectl set image -n metabob deployment/metabob-rpc-api rpc-api=metabob-rpc-api:surrealdb-v3
2. Wait for rollout: kubectl rollout status -n metabob deployment/metabob-rpc-api --timeout=180s
3. Check pod status: kubectl get pods -n metabob -l app=metabob-rpc-api
4. Check logs for startup errors: kubectl logs -n metabob deploy/metabob-rpc-api --tail=50
5. Verify no import errors or async warnings in logs

Expected: RPC API pod running with 1/1 Ready, no async/sync errors in logs

commands: kubectl get pods -n metabob -l app=metabob-rpc-api -o jsonpath='{.items[0].status.conditions[?(@.type=="Ready")].status}' | grep True

prompt.template:
Validate variant_id field persists correctly:

1. Port-forward RPC API: kubectl port-forward -n metabob svc/metabob-rpc-api 8080:8080 (background)
2. Create test metrics: curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/v2/activities/templates/test-v3-persistence-$(date +%s)/metrics -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"metrics": {"total_executions": 1, "success_rate": 1.0}}'
3. Get test ID from response
4. Query SurrealDB: kubectl exec -n metabob deploy/surrealdb -- surreal sql --endpoint http://localhost:8000 --namespace metabob --database production --username root --password root --command "SELECT variant_id, activity_id, total_executions FROM template_metrics WHERE variant_id CONTAINS 'test-v3-persistence' LIMIT 1;"
5. Verify variant_id is NOT NONE
6. Verify activity_id is NOT NONE

Expected: Both variant_id and activity_id fields have actual string values, not NONE

commands: kubectl exec -n metabob deploy/surrealdb -- surreal sql --endpoint http://localhost:8000 --namespace metabob --database production --username root --password root --command "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM template_metrics WHERE variant_id != NONE;" | grep -v '0'

tasks.description: Run validation harness and verify all tests pass

prompt.template:
Execute validation harness to confirm deployment success:

1. Run harness: bash tests/validation-harnesses/Complete-Async-Ripple-Changes-for-SurrealDB-Official-Library-harness.sh
2. Check results: All 6 tests should PASS
3. Generate summary report
4. Document any failures with details

Expected: 6/6 tests PASS, confirming:
- Official library working
- Async conversions complete
- variant_id persists correctly
- merge() preserves fields
- No sync/async errors
